source:
@@U04251@@
Thick darkness settles on the foe!
Which way to turn, they do not know.
Meteors crashing, blazing light,
Dazzle and confound the sight!
A marvelous view! But now, indeed,
A shattering sound is all we need.

@@U04253@@
The empty armor from ancient vaults
Finds itself revived in air.
Their rattling, banging, clattering there
Creates a discord without faults.

@@U04255@@
Quite right! They're not to be held back!
Fighting wildly, whack on whack,
The same as in the good old days.
With greaves and armlets, and cuisses, too,
Guelphs and Ghibellines renew
Full tilt their neverending frays.
Firm in inherited rancor, they
put implacable hate on display.
Now far and wide the tumult brays!
And so, at every devil’s féte,
Nothing succeeds like party hate,
Down to the last convulsive throe.
Wild sounds, that scatter fear and panic,
Mingled with piercing yells Satanic,
Ring down into the vale below.
(Tumultuous warlike music in the orchestra, finally giving way
to cheerful military music.)
translation:
@@U04251@@
浓浓的黑暗笼罩着敌人！
该往哪边走，他们不知道。
流星坠落，光芒四射，
让人眼花缭乱、眼花缭乱！
景色太棒了！但现在，确实，
我们所需要的只是破碎的声音。

@@U04253@@
古代金库中的空盔甲
发现自己在空气中复活了。
他们在那里发出嘎嘎声、撞击声、碰撞声
创造不和谐而无过错。

@@U04255@@
完全正确！他们不应该被阻止！
疯狂地战斗，猛烈地撞击，
和过去的美好时光一样。
还带着护腿、臂章和护腿，
圭尔夫派和吉伯林派续约
充分发挥他们永无休止的争斗。
他们怀着继承的仇恨，
表现出难以平息的仇恨。
现在喧嚣四起！
所以，在每一次魔鬼的盛宴上，
没有什么比党的仇恨更成功的了，
直到最后一阵痉挛般的阵痛。
狂野的声音驱散恐惧和恐慌，
夹杂着撒旦的刺耳叫喊，
环入下面的山谷。
（管弦乐队中喧嚣的战乐终于让位了
欢快的军乐。）
